purpose: Document first-party local cadastral/registry evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: The LMB FOI portal documents successful map delivery via request. Baguio public map site inspected is a COVID-case map with no parcel layer; city eBPLS is a payment service, not GIS. No complete anonymous parcel geometry endpoint or polygon response was verified.
registryAssessment: DENR-LMB’s official eFOI record documents successful provision of a Baguio City cadastral map; the City Assessor maintains real-property assessment within the city, but LMB is the direct cadastral-map custodian found.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official eFOI page lists DENR-LMB as custodian and records a successful response providing a city cadastral-map attachment. Access was request-based, not an anonymous public vector endpoint.
Official City Government portal links Baguio Open Data and local services; no parcel-vector service was identified in the inspected portal listings.
Official public map page is a thematic COVID-19 map with health/checkpoint layers, not parcel cadastre.
Official eBPLS handles business permits and real-property tax payments by billing identifiers; it is not a public parcel-map service.
